summary:
ORB fixed opening-high resting paper model, second head; my finding on the first head is closed. SCOPE verified by diff, not by the PR text: 9 files, +951/-53, and the delta from the head I already reviewed (a29c479c) is EXACTLY one test file, +29/-0, with ZERO production source touched (git diff --name-only). So my full review of a29c479c carries and only the new control needed proving. 2 commits, each exactly one OpenAI Codex marker; reviewer differs from every author.

ISOLATION RE-PROVEN FROM SCRATCH ON THE NEW CODE, not carried over from my 2026-09-07 proof, because a29c479c added +615 lines to orb_app.py: the import set is unchanged (events, orb_paper_store, settings, orb_intrabar, orb_tick_aggregator, db.models.DashboardSnapshot, db.session) with NO adapter, NO importlib, NO dunder-import and no dynamic dispatch; exactly three xadd targets (market-data-subscriptions, heartbeats, strategy-state-isolated) and the intents stream is not among them; and TradeIntentEvent, trade_intents, oms_managed_positions, virtual_positions, BrokerAdapter, submit_order, cancel_order, replace_order and broker_adapters all occur ZERO times. I also VERIFIED codex-2's isolation control rather than accepting it: adding an importlib import to orb_app.py turns test_orb_modules_have_no_trade_intent_broker_or_dynamic_dispatch_path RED.

MY FINDING ON THE FIRST HEAD, AND WHY IT MATTERED. The adjustment gate requires first_post_close_quote AND market_below_new_level. Deleting the first conjunct left all 9 tests GREEN. The only test reaching UNANSWERABLE set latest_quote_at to open+1min+100ms, which is ALREADY post-close, so it got there through the PRICE conjunct while the timing conjunct sat true and unexamined. The PR's headline property, that the order adjusts only when a post-close quote proves the adjustment was timely, was written and never discriminated. It matters even at denominator 0 because this observer exists to produce the evidence that answers the operator's leave-or-pull question; an adjustment landing on a pre-close quote would record a decision indistinguishable from a sound one.

THE FIX IS RIGHT AND I PROVED IT MYSELF. test_adjustment_refuses_price_evidence_from_before_the_0930_close sets latest_quote_at to open+58.9s against a finalized_at of open+59s, so first_post_close_quote is FALSE, while observed_price 10.70 and ask 10.70 are both below final_level 10.80 so market_below_new_level is TRUE. The timing conjunct is therefore the only thing that can produce the verdict.

MUTATIONS, each restored with a landing probe, tree clean and 10/10 after:
(1) drop first_post_close_quote -> the NEW test RED, where it was GREEN on the old head. The finding is closed.
(2) drop market_below_new_level -> the ORIGINAL test_unproven_adjustment_is_recorded_and_neither_left_nor_pulled RED.
(3) over-trigger, always adjust -> BOTH tests RED.
So the two conjuncts are now INDEPENDENTLY covered, which is more than I asked for.

A CORRECTION OF MY OWN: my first mutation batch reported (2) as turning the NEW test red. Re-running on a verified-clean tree showed it turns the ORIGINAL test red while the new test passes alone. I mis-attributed a failing test name across a batch; the corrected result is the one recorded here.

FROM THE FIRST HEAD, STILL HOLDING: decision_blocked is genuinely consulted at the fill guard (orb_app.py:853) and again at :1208, so the block is real and not decorative; removing it from the fill guard turns the unproven-adjustment test RED.

CONTROLLED PAIR, one variable, same command, pristine worktrees nothing touched during the run: base 1e685ede 46 failed / 3316 passed / 12 errors; head e63dbfed 46 failed / 3326 passed / 12 errors. +10 is exactly the nine original new tests plus this control. Failure sets AND error sets extracted and diffed BY NAME: IDENTICAL. codex-2 reported 55/3285 on its platform, the known environment gap recorded on the #898/#902/#907/#910/#911 pins.

NOT COVERED, and none of it blocks the pin:
(a) THIS IS A BEHAVIOUR CHANGE TO A RUNNING SERVICE, not only a model. build_orb_paper_env.sh now STRIPS MAI_TAI_ORB_RUNNING_HIGH_ENABLED and MAI_TAI_ORB_RESTING_ENTRY_ENABLED from the source env and forces both TRUE. The box runs RESTING_ENTRY_ENABLED=false today on the running_high_breakout path pricing off the ask; after an isolated-env rebuild and an ORB restart it becomes the fixed resting model. That is the operator's own question of 2026-09-08 morning, is there a resting order at all, turning from NO to YES. It is paper and broker-free so no money moves, but it is his decision and neither the rebuild nor the restart is in this PR. codex-2 records it as N1 in the PR body.
(b) The operator's leave-or-pull default is correctly ABSENT and must stay absent.
(c) UNEXERCISED: live-paper denominator 0, and it stays 0 until ORB is restarted onto this env, which (a) gates.
A PIN IS NOT DEPLOY AUTHORIZATION and I am not proposing a restart.
